heading: Professional Security Services
html:
What We Do

Professional Security Services

From crowd control to site security — one team with real law enforcement experience, one accountable contract.

Apartment Complex Security

Professional guards keep your community safe, handling resident concerns with courtesy and professionalism. Available 24/7 or on scheduled shifts.

Learn More

Public Auctions

Crowd control and asset protection for public auctions of all sizes. Our guards manage traffic flow and secure merchandise and equipment.

Learn More

Construction Sites

Secure your tools, equipment, and materials from theft. Our guards are present during and after hours to protect your valuable assets.

Learn More

Festivals & Major Events

Large crowd management for festivals, concerts, and major public gatherings. We handle safety at public events with experienced personnel.

Learn More

Sporting Events

Keep athletes and spectators safe at sporting events, conventions, and tournaments. Professional security at professional and amateur venues.

Learn More

Concerts

Venue security and crowd control for concerts and live performances. We manage safety for both indoor and outdoor concert venues.

Learn More

High School Events

From sporting events to proms and graduations, we keep your school events safe. Our staff works seamlessly with school administrators.

Learn More

Restaurant & Hospitality

Overnight and maintenance-period security for restaurants and hospitality venues. We protect your establishment during vulnerable hours.

Our licensed private investigators provide discreet, professional investigative services for individuals and businesses throughout Pennsylvania.

heading: Founded by Law Enforcement, Built on Trust
html:
Our Story

Founded by Law Enforcement, Built on Trust

M&G Security was founded in 1997 by former Reading Police Sergeant Mark N. Pellicciotti and retired Pennsylvania State Trooper Anthony DiGuglielmo.

Our staff consists of active and retired law enforcement personnel with over 60 years of combined experience. We have been proudly serving Berks County and surrounding areas for over 27 years.

From the Santander Arena to local construction sites, high school proms to corporate offices, we bring the discipline, training, and professionalism of law enforcement to every assignment.
